# Opening Hours
Updated: 2026-02-10

## Weekdays
We are open Monday to Friday from nine in the morning until six in the evening.
The counter closes fifteen minutes before the shop closes.

## Weekends
We are open on Saturday from nine until four.
We are closed on Sunday, except in December when Sunday hours are nine until two.

## Holidays
We close on public holidays.
Holiday hours are posted on the door and on our website the week before.
